Unresolved source identity discrepancy: the original JCM197 table spells NaS2, while its preparation spells Na2S. MediaDive normalizes the table to Na2S; TOGO retains NaS2. The existing label/grounding is preserved, not recertified, and no numeric sulfide concentration is asserted.

solutions.preparation_notes: Receiving-medium instructions (context only; not a stock-batch recipe): Mix ingredients except NaHCO3, Trace vitamins, Na2S・9H2O and cysteine・HCl・H2O, and autoclave under a N2--CO2 (80:20) atmosphere. Filter--sterilize NaHCO3 as an 8% solution and Trace vitamins while gassing with N2. Separately autoclave Na2S・9H2O and cysteine・HCl・H2O as 5% solutions under a N2 atmosphere. Aseptically and anaerobically add NaHCO3 and Trace vitamins to the medium under a N2--CO2 (80:20) atmosphere. Prior to inoculation, add the sterile Na2S・9H2O and cysteine・HCl・H2O solutions, and adjust pH to 6.8.
solutions.notes: The source specifies a separate percentage-labelled preparation but does not establish percentage basis or its addition volume. No numeric stock strength or dose is asserted. Composition notes record the receiving-batch contribution only.
